items.title: What Does Fiserv (FISV) Gain From Its New Merchant Services Partnership?
items.summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) announced a new global partnership with Mastercard to integrate advanced merchant services into Mastercard Merchant Cloud. The collaboration is aimed at simplifying commerce for large enterprise merchants and expanding Fiserv's value-added services offering. Through this agreement, Fiserv plans to broaden its global merchant reach by connecting its platform to Mastercard's cloud based infrastructure.
